Switched-on features and limits. Contains no secret and no customer data.
The categories, colours and materials search resolves words to.
Sentences known to work, for empty search and room-planner screens.
Return the identity established by the verified access token.
Return one deterministic page of recommendation-eligible products.
Return one eligible product without revealing why other records are hidden.

post.description: Parse one sentence, then rank the products the caller is allowed to see.
Plan a room of real products from one sentence.
Render a labelled preview of real products the caller may see.

get.description: Suggest real products of the same kind that share facts with this one.
Newest first. Exactly one of `product_id` or `seller_id` is required.

AlternativeResponse.title: AlternativeResponse
AlternativeResponse.description:
A real product that missed, and exactly what it missed by.

Offered only when nothing matched. Section 6.10 allows nearest real
alternatives and forbids fabricating a product; these are catalogue rows
that failed the fewest constraints, with the shortfall stated plainly so a
customer can decide whether to relax.

ExclusionResponse.title: ExclusionResponse
ExclusionResponse.description:
How many candidates this one hard constraint would have removed.

Deterministic, and the honest answer to "why did I get nothing?". Phase 4D
already counts this while filtering, so surfacing it costs nothing and
turns an empty result from a dead end into a reason.

The counts overlap and do not sum to the number excluded. A product that
is both the wrong category and over budget is counted under each, which is
what makes the largest count the binding constraint to relax first.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Strict response schema for the service health check.

InterpretationResponse.title: InterpretationResponse
InterpretationResponse.description:
What the backend understood the sentence to mean.

Returned so a client can show the customer what was understood, and
correct it. Every value here survived vocabulary resolution and bounds
checking, so it is what the search actually ran.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description: Public response for the current authenticated user.

RangeResponse.title: RangeResponse
RangeResponse.description: An inclusive bound the customer stated. Units follow the field name.

ReasonResponse.title: ReasonResponse
ReasonResponse.description:
One grounded statement about a product, in the customer's language.

``code`` is stable and machine-readable; ``text`` is display copy built
from catalogue values. Section 6.6 of the master plan requires catalogue
fact, inference, and aesthetic judgement to stay separate, so every reason
here is the first kind: a number or a term the catalogue actually holds.

RoomImageRequest.title: RoomImageRequest
RoomImageRequest.description:
Which real products to render. Ids only: the server looks each one up
again under the caller's own token, so a client cannot render a product
it could not have been shown, or describe a product that does not exist.

SearchItemResponse.title: SearchItemResponse
SearchItemResponse.description: One matching product and the grounded reason it matched.

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description: The only user-controlled input, bounded before a provider call is spent.

UnresolvedResponse.title: UnresolvedResponse
UnresolvedResponse.description: A word the vocabularies did not recognise, reported rather than guessed.

UpgradeResponse.title: UpgradeResponse
UpgradeResponse.description:
A better-matching option for one line, for a little more money.

Offered only when it scores higher on what the customer asked for, and
costs at most 15% past the budget it would exceed. ``reasons`` say exactly
what it matches that the current pick does not; nothing here claims a
product is nicer or of higher quality.

app__search__responses__TermResponse.title: TermResponse
app__search__responses__TermResponse.description: A resolved vocabulary term: a stable slug and a label to show.
